# SocialSlide

The Instagram and Threads carousel template, authored at 1080 × 1350 (or 1080 × 1920 for stories) and scaled for preview.

`Gathr.SocialSlide` · Social

## Use

```jsx
<Gathr.SocialSlide pillar={…} headline="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Gathr.SocialSlide" pillar="{{…}}" headline="…"></x-import>
```
